ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels occupying >95% of the visible surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at distal margins and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity field across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric clusters are concentrated at the extreme distal tips. Sparse, stochastic linear white filaments are distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern. The right lobe (viewer perspective) trailing edge exhibits a prominent macro-indentation roughly one-third inward from the distal tip. The left lobe exhibits finer, higher-frequency pixel-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Compound curve transitioning from a convex arc near the median notch to a concave sweep approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groupings localized on the leading and trailing edges of both distal tips, consistent with sessile organism colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions; specifically, a group of three parallel vertical scratches on the inner right lobe and multiple short, unaligned marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable non-uniform indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from standard serration peaks.
